sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; modest greed reading (67) suggests caution; neutral AAII sentiment and absent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 93.9 crisis regime) combined with earnings binary event in 9 days create hostile trading environment for ABBV despite falling USD tailwind.
